Senses.Explanation: The title occurs with the title-bearer's eyes, activity, or hand in the retained records. Yuanwu Keqin says that supporting the school requires eyes and activity qualified by this title. White-Cliff Fu calls for a bearer of the title to show his hand; Cuiyan Zhe joins the title to cutting nails and shearing iron; Liao'an Qingyu sets it beside picking one up and putting one down. The first component consistently modifies the title noun.
